title: Wanderer's Guild
description: Professions for dnd5e built on tool proficiencies: a character has every profession whose tool they are proficient with, and its rank follows the proficiency bonus. Recipes and crafting with the linked tool check, on rules the GM fills in. A GM setup window, a Professions window and a Crafting window per character.

recommends.reason: Optional. Crafting prices can show and charge the toolkit's three-coin economy (read through its API; setup › Settings).
Optional. A later version may hand gathered items out with Item Piles when it is active.
